user.title: Sign in to the EU Data Act portal
user.description: Use the same brand account you sign in to eu-data-act.drivesomethinggreater.com with. A continuous data request must already be set up for the vehicle on the portal.

data_description.brand: The brand whose account the vehicle is linked to.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The portal no longer accepts the password for {email}.

error.invalid_auth: The e-mail or password was rejected.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the EU Data Act portal. It may be temporarily down; try again later.
error.no_data_request: This vehicle has no continuous data request. Set one up under Data clusters on the portal, then try again.
error.action_required: Your account needs attention before it can be used, for example new terms of use to accept. Sign in once at eu-data-act.drivesomethinggreater.com in a browser, then try again.

abort.no_vehicles: No vehicles are linked to this account on the EU Data Act portal.

auth_failed.message: The EU Data Act portal rejected the credentials.

no_data.message: The EU Data Act portal has no data for this vehicle yet. Check that a continuous data request is active.

update_failed.message: Could not fetch data from the EU Data Act portal: {error}

action_required.message: The EU Data Act portal needs you to sign in once in a browser, for example to accept new terms of use.

recorder_not_loaded.message: History can only be imported while the recorder is running.

entry_not_found.message: The selected vehicle is not a VW Group EU Data Act entry.

path_not_allowed.message: Home Assistant may not read {path}. Put the export in the media folder, or in the www folder of the configuration folder, or add its folder to allowlist_external_dirs.

unreadable_export.message: The file could not be read as a one-off export: {error}

wrong_vehicle.message: The export is for a different vehicle than the selected entry.

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Adds the history in a one-off export from the EU Data Act portal to the long-term statistics of the vehicle's sensors. Only the time before existing statistics is filled in.

config_entry_id.name: Vehicle
config_entry_id.description: The vehicle the export belongs to.

path.name: Export file
path.description: The downloaded export, as a JSON file or the ZIP holding it, in the media folder (such as /media/export.json) or the www folder (www/export.json). A relative path is read from the configuration folder.
